name: heigan
_comment: Heigan eruption dance as data via timed_safe_zone: fast (7s/4s) + slow (15s/10s) cadences sharing 4 safe-zone centers + the 3-2-1-0-1-2 walk. WHO/WHEN stays on the C++ triggers (Level-1); the suppress block is the data-driven HeiganDanceMultiplier. See BossNotes/Heigan.md. Test 25-man.

rules._comment: Fast dance (everyone): hold while parked (no cast, tight 4s cadence), cast instants while moving.
Slow dance, ranged: yield once parked (cast freely in the 10s window), cast instants while moving between wedges.
Slow dance, tank + melee: park on the SE platform. Kept as the C++ 'heigan platform' action for its Heigan-specific final-8s bleed-off timing.

suppress._comment: Fast phase: zero everything that would hijack a yielded dance tick (eruption-dodge / range-chase / formation / flee AND the C++ 'heigan dance'). 'reach melee' suppressed too, since Heigan stays targetable and a freed melee would chase him off the dance floor.

Slow phase: same suppression minus 'reach melee' (slow-phase melee need it to close on the platform). 'heigan platform' is left alone (the json platform rule uses it). Gated by aura-absence so it covers all roles.
